## Raw strings

```r
r"(raw string)"
R"{another raw string}"
R"--[yet another ]- raw string]--"

r"(")"
r"("")"
r"(')"
r"('')"

r"-(-)-"
r"-()-)-"
r"--()-")--"

r"( () )"
r"(())"
r"( ())"
r"(() )"
r"-())-"
r"-(())-)-"

r"(raw
string
)"

# Empty raw strings
r"()"
r'()'
R"{}"
r"--[]--"

# Leading whitespace and newlines after open
r"(  hello)"
r"(\nhello)"
r"(
hello
)"
f(r"(\nhello\n)")
f(r"(
hello
)")

# Single quoted raw strings
r'(a)'
r'(')'
r'(")'

r()
```

## Raw strings with `|`

R accepts `|` as a raw string delimiter, though `?Quotes` doesn't say so.

```r
r"|raw string|"
R'|raw string|'
r"--|a|--"

r"||"
r"|||"
r"|a|b|"
r"-|a|-|-"

r"|(|"
r"(|)"
```
